lateral_movement_timeline.evidence: Mail journal entry on mail.nexabank.com (203.0.113.45), Sysmon EID=11 on robi-laptop.nexabank.local.

lateral_movement_timeline.action: rb1.exe beacons to c2.darkstorm.example every 60s. Initial recon: `whoami /all`, `net group "Domain Admins" /domain`.
AS-REP roast against nexabank.local — 3 accounts returned, svc_backup hash extracted.
lateral_movement_timeline.evidence: DC event 4768 (Kerberos AS), 4769 (Kerberos TGS) — anomalous burst from 10.10.5.17.

lateral_movement_timeline.action: WinRM as svc_backup → dc01.nexabank.local (10.10.1.5). Files copied via SMB: rb1.exe, loader.dll.
lateral_movement_timeline.evidence: DC event 4624 (logon type 3), 4688 (process creation cmd.exe -> powershell.exe).

lateral_movement_timeline.action: DCSync executed. NTLM hashes of all 1,847 employees + krbtgt extracted.
lateral_movement_timeline.evidence: DC event 4662 — Replication Get-Changes-All right exercised by svc_backup. Splunk rule 'AD Replication by non-DC account' fired (but was suppressed by ticket NXB-OPS-9912 — investigating).

lateral_movement_timeline.action: Lateral to db-prod.nexabank.local (10.10.1.22) via WMI as Administrator. Database dump initiated.
lateral_movement_timeline.evidence: Oracle audit log shows 142,000 rows read from CUSTOMERS table by user SYS over a 6-minute window.

lateral_movement_timeline.action: Exfil 8.4 GB DB dump via HTTPS POST to https://c2.darkstorm.example/api/exfil over a 22-minute window.
lateral_movement_timeline.evidence: NetFlow on egress firewall — 8.4 GB outbound 10.10.1.22 → 185.220.101.42 (resolves to c2.darkstorm.example via Cloudflare).

lateral_movement_timeline.action: Suspicious LSASS access detected — incident opened.
lateral_movement_timeline.evidence: Saved search 'Suspicious DC LSASS Access' fired.

containment_actions.action: Disabled svc_backup and svc_jenkins accounts in AD.
Isolated dc01.nexabank.local (10.10.1.5) and db-prod.nexabank.local (10.10.1.22) via firewall.
Forced password rotation for all 1,847 employees. krbtgt rotated twice (3 hours apart per Microsoft guidance).
Blocked egress to c2.darkstorm.example and 185.220.101.42/32 at perimeter.
Wiped robi-laptop.nexabank.local (10.10.5.17). Issued replacement to Roberto Silva. Forensic image preserved.
